## Activity

During August 2021, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 9 captures. This is the activity total for the reporting period and provides the basis for review of image quality and grading outcomes. The activity figure should be considered alongside the results reported below, including the number of images that could not be assessed and the number requiring referral.

## Image quality

Image quality review identified 1 ungradable capture. The ungradable rate was 11.1 per cent. This result is recorded for routine operational monitoring and should be considered when reviewing the service’s overall performance. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be followed up through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

Grading identified 3 referable results. The median lag from capture to grade was 1 day. These figures summarise the grading workload and the time taken for images to progress from capture to review during August 2021. Further operational attention should remain focused on recurring camera issues and their potential effect on image quality.
